state.seed_assertion: GDPR Article 35(3) states that DPIAs are mandatory where a data controller performs automated decision-making based on personal data profiling.

sentences.1: GDPR Article 35(3) states that DPIAs are mandatory where a data controller performs automated decision-making based on personal data profiling.
sentences.2: GDPR Article 35(3) states that DPIAs are mandatory in a number of processing scenarios.
sentences.3: These arise where a data controller performs automated decision-making based on personal data profiling, large scale processing of special categories of data or systematic monitoring of publicly accessible areas on a large scale.
sentences.4: A DPIA is required for a systematic and extensive evaluation of the personal aspects of an individual based on automated processing, including profiling.
sentences.5: A DPIA is required at least in the following cases: a systematic and extensive evaluation of the personal aspects of an individual based on automated processing, including profiling
sentences.6: Systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects based on automated processing, including profiling, on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person, is one type of processing that always requires a DPIA.
sentences.7: Article 35(3) sets out three types of processing which always require a DPIA: Systematic and extensive profiling with significant effects: "(a) any systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person."
sentences.8: A DPIA is required in the case of a systematic and extensive evaluation of personal aspects relating to natural persons which is based on automated processing, including profiling, and on which decisions are based that produce legal effects concerning the natural person or similarly significantly affect the natural person.
